changes.comment: Add opt-in ambient diagnostics and load-time duplicate-install detection. New on the main entry point: setStrictAmbient/getStrictAmbient and getCompatPatchInfo. New '/internal' subpath export carrying setAmbientTrace, a debugging aid held outside the semver promise. No default behaviour changes: strict mode and the trace are off by default, and the duplicate report only fires on an install that is already broken.
